text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And now, the moment we've all been
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Our Umamusume of the Year! She's the
brightest
star of the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
A runner with unparalleled power and
speed—and
the first sprinter in URA
history to be selected...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our first three years together have
passed by,
just like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I think back on the precious—and
rather
overwhelming—days we spent
side by side...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdyyy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You awake, Trainer? I know ya are!
C'mon, let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I haven't told ya yet! I'm
throwin' a
special party!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's a surprise party to celebrate
everything
you've done for me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ya better believe this'll be a day to
remember!
Now, I ain't gonna repeat
myself again—let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is intense, but she's gone
out of
her way to prepare a party for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I resolve to accept whatever comes in
good
stride, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Here we are! Surprise!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Back in the US, my family barbecues
right out in
the fields of our farm.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I want ya to know what that feels like,
and I
reckon this is the closest thing to
it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And before ya get all in a tizzy, I already
got the
go-ahead to do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I should have known Taiki would have
something
extravagant planned.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There's usually somethin' going on here,
but it's
quiet as a dormouse today.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wide, open spaces like this just make
me feel like
hollerin'! Yodel-ay-hee-hoo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now, let's get this party started!
I'll be your
grill master for today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although I have no issue with indulging
in a
barbeque, I suspect all this meat
may be an issue
for my stomach later.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Quit your foolin', Trainer! You can't be
full up
already. I brought dessert and
everything...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I guess when you're full, you're
full. Let's
put down our forks for a
minute, then.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Seein' as how we're here and
all, a
quick run couldn't hurt!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll get it later! I'm an Umamusume—ya
can't
expect me to just stay put in front
of a track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki takes off running without another
word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is a lot of things—she's
animated,
energetic, and awe-inspiring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And even more so on the track. I find
myself more
and more captivated every
time she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I realize that she hasn't come
back yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make my way to the track in search of
Taiki
Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Sob...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer... I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today was supposed to be all about
you... I told
myself I wouldn't cry, and
yet...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah! I feel so lonely! I can't take it
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Our three years together are over!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanna keep runnin' with ya! I wanna
have more
parties with ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With our third year almost over, she
seems to be
feeling distraught over us
going our separate
paths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But there's no reason the newly crowned

Umamusume of the Year and I have to
part ways.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya mean? Don't we have to say
goodbye
once our three years are up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain to her that such a thing only
happens
when a pairing has failed to
achieve satisfactory
results.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe this! I was dead certain
that was
how it worked! Japanese sure is
tricky!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So does that mean I get to keep runnin'
with ya,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeehaaaw! I'm sooo happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Let's keep runnin' forever, just
you and me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll never stop. I'll run for my family and
my fans...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And I'll run for you too, Trainer! I
promise to
always keep ya smiling!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for everything you've done for
me! Let's
stick together from here on
out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running beside her and help her
put on a
series of performances that no
one will forget!
